messages:
Priya K: EU4 GPU cluster (eu-central-4) provisioning complete — health checks green. Ready for SRE acceptance and pager flip. Can the on-call team run the quick validation checklist and confirm ownership? @Alex M can you handle PD mapping?

Alex M: On it. Quick acceptance checklist I care about:
- nodes present & Ready
- GPU count matches capacity plan
- kubelet disk pressure / kube-proxy errors
- core alerts wired into PD
- runbook link + jump host access

Jun Park: Running smoke now. First check:
```
kubectl get nodes -l region=eu4 -o wide
NAME       STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION   GpuCount
eu4-node-1 Ready    <none>   2h    v1.27     8
eu4-node-2 Ready    <none>   2h    v1.27     8
eu4-node-3 Ready    <none>   2h    v1.27     4
```
GPU counts match the provisioning doc (20 total). kubelet logs show one transient OOM in docker shim — cleared after kubelet restart.

Sara L: PagerDuty service is `eu4-inference` already created (PD id svc_eu4_92). Routing key assigned to SRE rotation. Does everyone have PD access? If not ping me.

Ops Bot: deploy-bot: cluster eu4 promoted to 'staging' namespace. Alerts provisioned: `eu4-node-failure`, `eu4-gpu-memory-pressure`, `eu4-network-degraded`.

Priya K: Escalation matrix for new region:
P1: On-call SRE -> 15m -> Alex M (Infra Lead) -> 30m -> Eng Prod Pager
P2: On-call SRE -> 30m -> Eng Prod Pager
Contact list: Priya K (owner), Alex M (infra lead), Jun Park (region ops), Sara L (PD admin)
Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/eu4-provisioning

Alex M: I've updated PD routing rules: if event.metadata.region == "eu4" AND event.service == "inference" -> route to eu4-inference. Also added auto-ack only for maintenance windows. I'll host a 30m acceptance + training session tomorrow 10:00 UTC — join if you're on rotation.

Jun Park: Validation script I used (commit in infra repo). Run:
```
./scripts/eu4-validate.sh --smoke --alerts
```
It runs node/GPU checks, pulls latest GPU driver metrics, verifies Prometheus alert rules and does a sample failover of a node (cordon/drain) to ensure autoscaler + fallback works.

Sample PromQL for GPU memory alert I added:
```
avg by(instance) (nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) > 0.9
```
Sustained 5m -> fires `eu4-gpu-memory-pressure`.

Sara L: Please add cost alert: if total GPU-hours for region > 1200 in 24h -> post to #cost-alerts and page SRE.

Priya K: Action items before flipping pager:
- [ ] Alex confirm PD routing and escalation (done: svc_eu4_92)
- [ ] SRE on-call confirm runbook access & jump host
- [ ] Add cost alert (Sara)
- [ ] Schedule training (Alex) — 10:00 UTC tomorrow

Alex M: LGTM, I've confirmed PD and added temp access for oncall staff.

Jun Park: LGTM

Sara L: :thumbsup:

Ops Bot: reminder: oncall-training doc https://internal/ops/training scheduled.

Priya K: I'll flip pager at 10:30 UTC tomorrow if no objections. Thanks team :rocket:
